Main.sentence: Nawar " Nora " al-Awlaki ( ___E:Arabic U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_language)___ : نوار العولقي ; 2008/09 – January 29, 2017), the 8-year-old daughter of ___E:Anwar al-Awlaki U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anwar_al-Awlaki)___ , was killed on January 29, 2017, during the ___E:Raid on Yakla U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raid_on_Yakla)___ , a commando attack ordered by U.S.

Conducted in southern ___E:Yemen U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yemen)___ , the raid was an attempted attack on a branch of the terrorist group ___E:Al-Qaeda U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al-Qaeda)___ .

The raid in southern Yemen was conducted by the ___E:Joint Special Operations Command U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joint_Special_Operations_Command)___ and was, according to a senior U.S. military official, intended to capture intelligence stored on computers.
According to U.S. officials, in addition to the death of Nawar al-Awlaki, a U.S.
Navy SEAL and three al-Qaeda leaders were killed.
Nawar al-Awlaki's death gained national coverage and attention in both mainstream and online media sources.
Nawar's grandfather, ___E:Nasser al-Awlaki U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nasser_al-Awlaki)___ , said of her killing, "She was hit with a bullet in her neck and suffered for two hours.
This is the new U.S. administration – it's very sad, a big crime."  Nawar died with her mother and uncle by her side. Her alleged last words were, "Don't cry, mama. I'm fine."
Nawar was the third member of her immediate family killed during military orders issued with ___E:executive powers U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Executive_branch_(US))___ .

Her father, ___E:Anwar al-Awlaki U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anwar_al-Awlaki)___ , was the first to be killed by the executive branch when on September 30, 2011, CIA orders calling for a ___E:precision drone strike U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AGM-114_Hellfire)___ targeting him  were given ___E:presidential approval U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Targeted_killing)___ by President ___E:Barack Obama U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barack_Obama)___ .

Anwar al-Awlaki was alleged by the U.S. government to be a leader of ___E:al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al-Qaeda_in_the_Arabian_Peninsula)___ that had gone "operational",  although the US government has refused to declassify much of the evidence that led them to this conclusion.
Two weeks after the death of her father, Nawar's sixteen-year-old half-brother, ___E:Abdulrahman U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abdulrahman_al-Awlaki)___ , was also killed in a U.S. drone strike.
